story.title: Box Office soars on Day 5: Ramayana nets Rs 107.50cr in India
story.summary: Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash’s ‘Ramayana: Rise of a Legend’, released November 5, 2026, continues its strong run. On Day 5, it earned Rs 107.50 crore net in India, taking the total to Rs 346.35 crore net. Worldwide gross stands at Rs 663.90 crore. Part two is slated for Diwali 2028.
